testimonials.name: Sara Figueroa
testimonials.pullQuote: this was the first time I experienced real, lasting results.
testimonials.story: I started at 67kg and followed the program for 6 days. Within a few days I had already lost 4kg, which I found incredible. A few weeks later I am sitting at 56kg, with significantly more energy and better sleep. I had previously tried countless weight loss products and fat burners without success — this was the first time I experienced real, lasting results.

My skin is glowing, I feel significantly better overall, and I've now referred over 15 people who are currently doing the program.

testimonials.name: Mark
